operating_notes.text: NHPC declared the CoD of the third 250 MW unit of the 2,000 MW Subansiri Lower HE Project as 08.05.2026 00:00; CoD of the remaining units to be intimated.
NHPC's stake in subsidiary Chenab Valley Power Projects Limited fell from 58.16% to 50.86% after co-promoter JKSPDCL made an additional equity contribution.
FY26 ATS charges of ₹822.19 Cr on the Subansiri Lower project were recognised as a regulatory deferral debit balance after a CERC order dated 16.01.2026.
750 MW of the 2,000 MW Subansiri Lower project and the 300 MW Karnisar solar project were commissioned during FY26; a further 250 MW unit came on May 8, 2026, taking Subansiri to 1,000 MW.
Deferred tax liabilities were remeasured at concessional rates under the Income Tax Act, 2025, cutting deferred tax expense by ₹1,156.60 Cr for FY26.
Subansiri Lower project expected generation is around 5,000 to 5,500 million units.
Raised ₹2,000 Cr via 7.67% AI Series unsecured redeemable bonds due 2041 with annual repayments starting in year 6.
The promoter OFS totals 60,27,02,088 shares (6% of capital as on March 31, 2026) if the oversubscription option is exercised, with 10% of the offer reserved for retail investors.
Commissioned 1 unit of 250 MW from Subansiri Lower Project during Q1FY27, taking total commissioned capacity to 1000 MW (4 out of 8 units)
Commissioned 800 MW Parbati-11 HE Project in FY25-26, with provisional sales recognised pending CERC approval
Commissioned Unit 5 (250 MW) of Subansiri Lower HE Project on October 23, 2026, bringing total commissioned units to 5.

timeline.summary: On 5 May 2026 NHPC declared the commercial operation date of the third 250 MW unit of its 2,000 MW Subansiri Lower HE Project as 8 May 2026, with the remaining units' CoD to be intimated.

On 11 May 2026 NHPC said its shareholding and voting rights in subsidiary Chenab Valley Power Projects Limited fell from 58.16% to 50.86% after co-promoter JKSPDCL made an additional equity contribution.
NHPC Limited’s senior management will discuss Q4 FY2025-26 results and engage with analysts/investors on May 18, 2026, at 03:30 PM (IST) via conference call.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,815.53 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹1,460.16 Cr.
On May 25, 2026, NHPC announced participation in investor conferences in Mumbai scheduled for late May and early June 2026.
NHPC hosted its Q4FY26 earnings conference call on May 18, 2026.
On May 29, 2026, NHPC raised ₹2,000 Cr via 15-year 7.67% AI Series unsecured redeemable bonds on private placement.
On June 1, 2026, the Ministry of Power announced an Offer for Sale of up to 6% equity in NHPC Limited at a floor price of ₹71 per share.
On June 2, 2026, the Ministry of Power told the exchanges it would exercise the oversubscription option for 30,13,51,044 NHPC shares, taking the promoter OFS to 60,27,02,088 shares, 6% of capital.
On June 4, 2026, NHPC disclosed that the Ministry of Power completed a 6.01% promoter stake sale via OFS for ₹4,362.38 Cr.
16 July 2026: NHPC resumes commercial operations of Unit#3 (170 MW) at Teesta-V Power Station, completing all 510 MW capacity

On July 20, 2026, an incident occurred in the under-construction tunnel of Teesta VI HE Project (500 MW), Sikkim, due to suspected methane gas burst, resulting in 25 personnel trapped and 10 casualties reported.
NHPC reported Q1FY27 results with 18.5% YoY revenue growth to ₹3,808 Cr and 4.1% PAT growth to ₹1,178 Cr.
MCA fixed 25.08.2026 as hearing date for the scheme of amalgamation between Jalpower Corporation Limited and NHPC Limited.
NHPC postponed the final hearing date for the scheme of amalgamation with Jalpower Corporation Limited due to administrative exigencies at MCA.
NHPC Limited’s 50th AGM on August 28, 2026, approved all resolutions with 98.33% shareholder votes in favor via e-voting.
NHPC's ESG score revised down to 57 by S&P Global on 28.08.2026, following analysis of Teesta VI HEP incident

On 01.09.2026, Arbitral Tribunal awarded ₹392.31 Cr plus Euro 15,36,530 to M/s BGS-SGS-SOMA in arbitration over Subansiri Lower HE project works, claimable as project cost under CERC Tariff Regulations, 2024.
MCA fixed 28.09.2026 as hearing date for the scheme of amalgamation between Jalpower Corporation Limited and NHPC Limited.
NHPC commissioned Unit 5 (250 MW) of the Subansiri Lower HE Project on October 23, 2026.
